records.title: Measures — Early Years
records.treatment: Experience durations and attend to both start and end before unit fluency.
records.adopted: Actual temporal demonstration with repeat/stop, followed by discussion of starts and ends.
records.rejected: Do not make counting seconds or reading a clock the entry requirement for this qualitative KC.
records.usageRestrictions: Conceptual comparison only, no prose/figures copied; no redistribution licence inferred.
records.limitations: Foreign early-years guidance, younger than Finnish1–2; adaptation is a project decision, not proof of Finnish curriculum requirements or lesson efficacy.

records.title: Timing — Teachers: Early Years
records.treatment: Compare durations in practical activities with adult-supported timing.
records.adopted: An offline comparison of whole familiar events and opportunities for the learner to describe the comparison.
records.rejected: Counting how many objects someone handles is not by itself a measure of elapsed time; motor speed is not the response criterion here.
records.usageRestrictions: University of Cambridge copyright; no source task wording or figures copied.
records.limitations: A comparable activity guide, not an efficacy evaluation or a direct Finnish age-band prescription.

inventory.demo: Together-start candles and later-start/last-end trap with remaining-wax trace.
inventory.generators: Different/equal candle intervals, familiar-life duration choices, different-start transfer.
inventory.hint: Observe each start/end; equal initial heights and burn speed allow a remaining-length reminder in the model.
inventory.media: candleScene; motionsims mixes straight-track cars/arrival lamps into some items.
inventory.registry: SIM_SHARE guided0.6, independent0.35, retrieval0.5, transfer0. Base demos remain; WATCH gate belongs toM-TIME-03/PHY79-DIST-TIME.
inventory.audit: Rejected stationary tick/second boxes; reports candle and life-family correction. Audit is unapproved source history, not human acceptance.

alignment.inherited: Controllable temporal events and same-rate candle-length reminder; compare starts/ends without mandatory counting units.
alignment.extended: Both unequal and equal durations with different starts, explicit model assumptions and practical offline event comparison.
alignment.corrected: No inference that later finish always means longer duration, or that arbitrary real candle lengths prove burning time. No mandatory second unit/clock skill imported fromM-TIME-03.

planning.assumed: Meaning of before/after and event start/end is modelled. Counting seconds, numerical clock reading, naming geometric shapes or speech confirmation is not required.
coTaught: M-MEAS-00 (choose the attribute being compared, prerequisite retained)
planning.scope: Qualitative longer/shorter/equal duration including different beginnings. Not numerical time measurement, clock reading, speed calculation or combustion physics.
planning.evidenceLimits: Low-stakes full-event comparison only. No stored evidence, formal mastery, independence or retention claim.
planning.curriculumVsDesign: Frozen candidate is pedagogically derived; foreign primary guidance corroborates design, not a new OPH mandate. Story, displayed A/B labels, animation parameters and same-rate reminder are project design.
planning.assetProvenance: Original SVG and timeline renderer, informed by supplied Lite candle model; supplied unchanged Aava raster. Public licensing holds retained.

extensions.timingSemantics: stateAt accepts playback seconds only; remaining pixels are an illustrative same-rate trace. No physical candle-burning time unit is inferred or assessed.
